categories.main_business_segments: Fujian Supertech Advanced Material Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, development, production, and sales of vacuum insulation panels (VIP) and insulation boxes. The company also develops vacuum glass products and high-barrier films, serving mainly the home appliance and cold chain logistics sectors. Its subsidiaries focus on related materials and new applications in building insulation and energy storage.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company has proprietary technologies in core materials formulation, barrier membrane production, adsorbent preparation, vacuum packaging, and performance testing of vacuum insulation panels. It employs advanced manufacturing processes including shell-type four-edge sealing technology, fiber air-laid mat production, and automated vacuum packaging equipment. The company also develops vacuum glass manufacturing technology with low-temperature sealing and no-hole packaging.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include leading domestic and international home appliance manufacturers such as Haier, Midea, Samsung, LG, and Bosch, primarily serving the refrigerator and freezer markets. The company also supplies medical, biological, and food cold chain logistics sectors with insulation boxes. Emerging markets include new energy vehicle battery thermal management, building insulation, LNG equipment insulation, and high-temperature industrial insulation.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with production bases in Fujian and Anhui provinces and sales covering domestic and international markets including South Korea, Japan, Europe, and the Americas. Its products are supplied to global manufacturing bases of major appliance brands, with increasing domestic sales proportion.
categories.supply_chain_position: Fujian Supertech operates primarily in the midstream segment of the supply chain as a manufacturer of key insulation materials and components for downstream appliance and cold chain manufacturers. It integrates upstream raw material production such as core materials and barrier films, enabling full control over the production chain.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes continuous R&D investment to enhance product performance, reduce costs, and expand application fields. Key R&D directions include new production methods like shell-type four-edge sealing, development of diversified core materials, high-barrier membranes, and vacuum glass technology. It also focuses on automation, intelligent manufacturing, and expanding into new markets such as energy storage and building insulation.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through customized sales of vacuum insulation panels and insulation boxes to appliance manufacturers and cold chain logistics companies. The company employs direct sales and intermediary sales models, with pricing based on product specifications, performance, and market conditions negotiated per contract.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading domestic and global player in vacuum insulation materials, competing with specialized VIP manufacturers like Sichuan Maikelong and Chuzhou Yinxing, as well as in-house producers by large appliance brands such as Mitsubishi and Panasonic. It holds a strong market position due to advanced technology, scale, and stable relationships with top appliance manufacturers.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 933.5 million, an 11.16% increase year-over-year, with net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 77.16 million, a 27.27% decrease due to increased costs and investment in subsidiaries. Total assets reached nearly RMB 2 billion, with ongoing capacity expansion projects. R&D expenses accounted for 5.15% of revenue, reflecting a growth in innovation investment.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company offers high-performance, low thermal conductivity vacuum insulation panels with superior energy-saving capabilities, thin thickness, light weight, and environmental friendliness. Its integrated production chain ensures quality and cost advantages. Innovations like shell-type sealing improve durability and reliability. The company’s products meet stringent international standards and certifications, providing customers with customized, high-value insulation solutions that enhance appliance energy efficiency and support green building and new energy applications.
